card.name: Digits inside statistics numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point in the middle of a number in trial results, such as a denominator after a slash or the digits around a decimal point. It fires on the first digit of the denominator or the digit just after the point.

modes.label: Denominator after slash
modes.description: First digit of the total count in an n/N fraction, written in parentheses after a percentage.

modes.label: Decimal digits
modes.description: The decimal point or the digit after it inside a percentage or ratio.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number in a results table, such as the total in a count like 14/372 or the decimal part of a percentage.
